determinism.rng: per-family random.Random seeded with '<frozen_seed>|<family_id>'; all facts and object lists sorted before emission

discipline.instance_generation: public generator semantics re-implemented faithfully at the generator's OWN default parameters with the frozen seed; NO rejection sampling, NO difficulty filtering, NO oracle-informed selection; the stream is taken as authored; parse failures are the only exclusions and are retained with reasons
discipline.member_stream: each member draws its randomness from a deterministic per-family RNG stream seeded by (frozen_seed, family_id); re-running the emitter reproduces the family table byte-identically

exclusions_rule: parse failures are the only exclusions and are retained here with reasons; none occurred at emission

domain_provenance: domain:        BLOCKS (blocksworld)
competition:   International Planning Competition, IPC-2 (2000), "Blocks World"
basis:         transcribed from the standard IPC domain description
(typed STRIPS blocks world; actions pick-up/put-down/stack/unstack),
structured by hand from the published semantics -- NOT verbatim
IPC text; no IPC file was copied byte-for-byte.
subset:        types, predicates, actions with delete/add effects only
(no :derived, no :duration, no ADL, no conditional effects)
pipeline role: S1 external-authorship family domain (P1_PIPELINE_FREEZE_V1.json)

default_parameters.deal: round-robin: shuffled block list dealt into t towers, tower j receiving shuffled blocks j, j+t, j+2t, ...
default_parameters.goal_state: second independent deal (no re-roll if it equals the initial state; no solvability or distance filtering)

generator.semantics: IPC-2 (2000) Blocks World random-tower construction: blocks shuffled, dealt into a frozen number of towers; initial and goal states are two independent such deals. Structured by hand from the published generator semantics, not verbatim code.

domain_provenance: domain:        Logistics
competition:   International Planning Competition, IPC-1 (1998) / IPC-2 (2000)
basis:         transcribed from the standard IPC domain description
(packages/trucks within cities, airplanes between airports;
actions load/unload for truck and plane, drive-truck,
fly-airplane), structured by hand from the published
semantics -- NOT verbatim IPC text. Predicate and parameter
naming follows the all-positive STRIPS formulation (distinct
truck-at/airplane-at/obj-at/obj-in predicates, city bound as
an explicit drive-truck parameter) so that no negative
precondition is required anywhere in the domain.
subset:        types, predicates, actions with delete/add effects only
(no :derived, no :duration, no ADL, no conditional effects)
pipeline role: S1 external-authorship family domain (P1_PIPELINE_FREEZE_V1.json)

default_parameters.package_od: origin and destination drawn from the seeded family RNG over all locations; a destination equal to the origin is kept (no re-roll)

generator.semantics: IPC-1/IPC-2 Logistics generator: cities each with one airport and one extra location, one truck per city parked at its city airport, one airplane at the first city's airport, packages with seeded origin/destination pairs. Structured by hand from the published generator semantics, not verbatim code.
